Native-safe WidgetShell/DataFreshness/GlyphIcon are the same accepted pattern as the sibling AnalyticsSummaryWidget/BatteryCellsWidget ports: Skeleton (testID 'skeleton') while loading; a titled header row (icon + uppercase muted caption + freshness) or a title-less overlay freshness chip; DataFreshness is a Pressable(onRefresh) dot+label whose relative time is computed once at render (no interval) to avoid a dangling timer under --detectOpenHandles. The native WidgetDetailCard renders the web overflow-y-auto list as plain rows inside the outer ScrollView, slices to 4 when compact, and falls back to EmptyState; the native Badge covers both size='sm' call sites; date helpers use the device timezone (no ported useTimezone) with the settings locale, the KioskOverlay/ChargingCurvePage precedent.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/StyleSheet), the shared apps/native AppText/SemanticIcon/tokens, the native parity EmptyState/Skeleton, and the native parity useChargePlans/useRatePlans/useVehicles/useSettings hooks.
